hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -f .claude/crashlytics-context.md ]; then echo "Crashlytics context available at .claude/crashlytics-context.md"; else echo "No crashlytics context found"; fi'

bash -c 'STAMP=.claude/.last-memory-audit; if [ ! -f "$STAMP" ]; then echo "⚠ Memory audit never run — run /audit-memory"; else LAST=$(cat "$STAMP" 2>/dev/null); LAST_TS=$(date -j -f "%Y-%m-%d" "$LAST" +%s 2>/dev/null || date -d "$LAST" +%s 2>/dev/null); NOW=$(date +%s); if [ -n "$LAST_TS" ]; then DAYS=$(( (NOW - LAST_TS) / 86400 )); if [ "$DAYS" -gt 30 ]; then echo "⚠ Memory audit overdue ($DAYS days since last) — run /audit-memory"; fi; fi; fi'
bash -c 'echo "Reminder: commit after every logical change, subject [TAG] @Agent: description"'

bash -c 'PAYLOAD=""; [ -t 0 ] || PAYLOAD=$(cat 2>/dev/null || true); if printf "%s%s" "$PAYLOAD" "${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}" | grep -q "git commit"; then echo "Commit made — update board-context.md if task status changed"; fi'
